name: 9 Maja
source:
Erogame Project presents a tiny visual novel to celebrate the 9th of May (Victory Day), a great day, which marks the capitulation of Nazi Germany to the Soviet Union in the Second World War, a national holiday in Russia and many other countries. 

[From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/9mar.shtml]Ren'Py Games List[/url]]
translation:
Erogame Project呈献一部迷你视觉小说，庆祝5月9日胜利日——标志着第二次世界大战中纳粹德国向苏联投降的伟大日子，这是俄罗斯和许多其他国家的国定假日。

[来自[url=http://games.renpy.org/game/9mar.shtml]Ren'Py Games List[/url]]
